title: Wire a host graph executor and submit an external job once
narrative: Fangore builds a host that dispatches a remote coding job from a durable plan. They need a short, readable way to register that job step, choose durable storage, and submit exactly once — including after a crash where the remote system may already have accepted the job. Complements `fangore_graph_executor` (authorized plan walk) and `fangore_transactional_durable_resume` (crash-window reconciliation). Host wiring lives in the dependency-injection guide[^host-kit-di].
implementation: `mechaharness.host_kit.host_graph_executor` subclasses `MechaHarnessConfig` and injects a `GraphExecutor` with host runners, default graph grants, optional `SqliteCheckpointStore` via `checkpoint_path` / `checkpoint_store`, and an injectable `CrashProbe`. `SubmitOnceEffectfulRunner` implements submit-once / complete-on-accept. `CliInstrumentor` verb `host_kit_submit_once` runs the acceptance matrix. Module doctests document the blessed host path.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `dispatch_and_resume.yaml`: hard `scenario_results_exactly` for durable dispatch and uncertain-with-handle resume. Unit matrix: `tests/fixtures/host_kit/*.json` via `tests/test_host_kit.py`.
